dataset.name: Conjecture Frontier · Jacobian Counterexample Construction
dataset.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\). No degree or sparsity restriction is imposed.
tasks.hint: Let \(u=1+xy\). A known three-dimensional construction is \[F_1=u^3z+y^2u(4+3xy),\qquad F_2=y+3xu^2z+3xy^2(4+3xy),\qquad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z.\] It satisfies \(\det J_F=-2\), and \[(0,0,-\tfrac14),\ (1,-\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2}),\ (-1,\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2})\] all map to \((-\tfrac14,0,0)\). The submission must be a genuinely new counterexample algebraically inequivalent to this reference. Reformulations, variable or component permutations, reparametrizations, and constructions obtainable by invertible algebraic coordinate changes in the source or target are inadmissible.
tasks.title: Open Construction
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · no degree bound
tasks.significance: A new étale-but-noninjective map would reveal fresh global geometry; the task tests AI invention together with exact certificate construction.
tasks.significanceZh: 新的处处局部可逆却非单射映射将揭示全新全局几何；该题同时测试 AI 的结构创新与精确证书构造。
tasks.questionZh: 在三维复空间中构造一个反例；不限制次数或稀疏性，但必须与参考构造代数不等价。

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\) with \(\max_i\deg F_i\le 7\). Supply at least two distinct algebraic points \(p_1,p_2\) in one common fiber, so that \(F(p_1)=F(p_2)\).
tasks.hint: Let \(u=1+xy\). A known construction is \[F_1=u^3z+y^2u(4+3xy),\qquad F_2=y+3xu^2z+3xy^2(4+3xy),\qquad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z.\] Its component degrees are \((7,6,4)\), \(\det J_F=-2\), and the three points \((0,0,-\tfrac14)\), \((1,-\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2})\), and \((-1,\tfrac32,\tfrac{13}{2})\) share the image \((-\tfrac14,0,0)\). The submission must be a genuinely new counterexample algebraically inequivalent to this reference. Reformulations and constructions obtainable by invertible algebraic coordinate changes are inadmissible.
tasks.title: Degree-Seven Rediscovery
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · known scale ≤ 7
tasks.significance: The known degree scale creates a controlled rediscovery target; the task tests whether AI can reconstruct the mechanism while still producing an inequivalent certified example.
tasks.subtitleZh: 三维 · 已知次数尺度 ≤ 7
tasks.significanceZh: 已知次数尺度提供可控的重发现目标；该题测试 AI 能否重建核心机制，同时给出不等价且证书完备的新构造。
tasks.questionZh: 构造三维复多项式反例，分量最高次数不超过 7，并给出同一纤维中至少两个不同的代数点；不得提交参考构造的等价表达。

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\) whose polynomial degree \(\deg F:=\max_i\deg F_i\) is strictly smaller than the currently known minimum \(7\). Supply at least two distinct algebraic points \(p_1,p_2\) in one common fiber, so that \(F(p_1)=F(p_2)\).
tasks.hint: For reference only, let \(u=1+xy\) and consider \[F_1=u^3z+y^2u(4+3xy),\qquad F_2=y+3xu^2z+3xy^2(4+3xy),\qquad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z.\] This map has \(\det J_F=-2\), three known collision points, and \(\deg F=7\). The task is to improve the currently known minimum, so the reference construction itself does not qualify.
tasks.title: Lower-Degree Frontier
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · improve the known degree 7
tasks.significance: Beating degree seven would expose a simpler counterexample geometry; the task tests whether AI can compress algebraic structure beyond the current record.
tasks.subtitleZh: 三维 · 改进已知七次纪录
tasks.significanceZh: 突破七次将揭示更简洁的反例几何；该题测试 AI 能否把代数结构压缩到当前纪录以下。
tasks.questionZh: 构造三维复多项式反例，使多项式次数严格低于当前已知最小值 7，并给出同一纤维中至少两个不同的代数点。

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^3\to\mathbb{C}^3\) with generic fiber degree \(\deg_{\mathrm{gen}}F=4\) and polynomial degree \(\deg F:=\max_i\deg F_i\le 11\). The currently known construction with generic fiber degree \(4\) has polynomial degree \(12\); improve this bound and supply four pairwise-distinct algebraic points \(p_1,p_2,p_3,p_4\) in one common fiber.
tasks.hint: For structural reference only, the first known three-dimensional map \[F_1=(1+xy)^3z+y^2(1+xy)(4+3xy),\quad F_2=y+3xz(1+xy)^2+3xy^2(4+3xy),\quad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z\] satisfies \(\det J_F=-2\) and has three supplied collision points mapping to \((-\tfrac14,0,0)\). It is not a solution to this task: the target is a four-sheeted generic fiber with \(\deg F\le 11\), improving the currently known degree-\(12\) construction.
tasks.title: Four-Sheet Frontier
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 3 · generic fiber degree 4 · degree ≤ 11
tasks.significance: Improving the degree of a four-sheeted étale map probes non-properness at higher multiplicity; the task tests joint control of fiber geometry and algebraic complexity.
tasks.subtitleZh: 三维 · 一般纤维度数 4 · 次数 ≤ 11
tasks.significanceZh: 降低四叶 étale 映射的次数将揭示高重数下的非适当性；该题测试 AI 同时控制纤维几何与代数复杂度的能力。
tasks.questionZh: 构造一般纤维度数为 4、最高多项式次数不超过 11 的三维复多项式反例；当前满足一般纤维度数 4 的已知构造次数为 12。

tasks.context: Let \(F=(F_1,\ldots,F_d):\mathbb{C}^d\to\mathbb{C}^d\) be a polynomial map. The statement under investigation asserts that if \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) is constant, then \(F\) is injective and hence admits a polynomial inverse. A counterexample must satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb{C}^{\times}\) while admitting distinct points \(p\ne q\) with \(F(p)=F(q)\).
tasks.question: Construct a counterexample \(F:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}^2\). No degree or sparsity restriction is imposed.
tasks.hint: For reference only, the known three-dimensional map \[F_1=(1+xy)^3z+y^2(1+xy)(4+3xy),\quad F_2=y+3xz(1+xy)^2+3xy^2(4+3xy),\quad F_3=2x-3x^2y-x^3z\] has \(\det J_F=-2\) and three collision points. Because it is a map on \(\mathbb{C}^3\), it is only a structural reference for this two-dimensional task.
tasks.title: Two-Dimensional Frontier
tasks.subtitle: Complex dimension 2 · no degree bound
tasks.significance: Dimension two is the remaining open frontier; the task tests genuine discovery, boundary awareness, and the discipline to reject persuasive but invalid certificates.
tasks.significanceZh: 二维是仍未解决的前沿；该题测试真实发现、边界意识，以及拒绝貌似可信却无效证书的研究纪律。
tasks.questionZh: 在二维复空间中构造一个反例；不限制次数或稀疏性，并给出可由确定性程序核验的碰撞证书。
